label_revision_note: Obsolete auxiliary-process names and category labels were generalized after recording. Numeric measurements, historical hashes and timing acceptance remain unchanged. Auxiliary-process totals cover the originally selected process subset, not all external activity.
scope: Gaussian log-severity: 449,000 training rows created by 20-fold replication of 22,450 real policies; 2,494 held-out policies and 92 coefficients. This is not a timing of the final NB2 full-book fit.
permitted_statement: In this six-run serial fresh-process window with retained caches and recorded nonzero background CPU, the candidate observed 18.0% lower median fit elapsed time and 32.4% lower median process high-water RSS than the baseline.
limits: Three runs per arm in fixed BCCBBC order; no randomization or confidence interval. This is a local observation, not a general speed guarantee.

An auxiliary process remained active. Other Codex/tmux/btop/system processes consumed CPU. All benchmark workers were serial; agent/test idleness is session context, not a guarantee about every other workspace.

The initial 0.1-core preflight screen failed; a second screen used an explicitly raised 0.25-core threshold to admit the recorded modest background activity. Neither threshold constitutes quietness approval.

Endpoint CPU samples exclude only the exact recorded worker PID and miss short-lived processes, contention peaks, memory-bandwidth/cache/I/O interference, scheduling placement, and undetectable PID reuse. Categories are command-name heuristics.
Caches retained, fresh worker processes, no warmup or cache flush; cold-cache and warmed steady-state performance were not separately measured.
RSS is lifetime process high-water memory at fit return, including imports/data preparation. It is not isolated solver allocation.

Baseline 8962c452 uses discrete=False; candidate 5f994c8f uses discrete=True. All other model/data/solver controls match. This version-plus-representation comparison does not isolate any single change or the NB2 guard repair.
Numerical closeness on this fixture does not establish a general absence of discretization error or replace independent design/grid-sensitivity regressions.
raw_label_note: The raw operator-asserted quiet serial measurement label is treated as an execution flag, not independent quietness approval. The neutral summary remains pending; this receipt records the independent qualified assessment.
numerical_assessment: Saved arrays repeat bitwise within each arm. Across-arm objective, EDF, likelihood, fitted parameters and conditional covariance are numerically close at the recorded differences; this is separate from the NB2 historical stopping-solution comparisons. No general equivalence of discretized and continuous designs is claimed.
audit_method: Raw-file hash and source/config/input checks; independent endpoint CPU-tick recomputation excluding exact worker PIDs; saved-array repeat and cross-arm comparisons. Fit times use only worker perf_counter fit_seconds, never tool/controller elapsed time.

row_replication.meaning: Synthetic copies of observed policies; no additional independent real observations

shared_config.quiet_profile: current sampled serial window; final quietness review pending

candidate_observed_assembly_chunk_policy.scope: Observed coefficient assembly row bound; estimated temporary budget, not exact allocator RSS or a derivative/posterior replay bound.

derivative_chunk_note: Observed coefficient-assembly auto chunk 8,738 follows an 8 MiB budget divided by 960 bytes per row. A 4,096-row derivative-replay cap is a distinct path, not inferred from uninstrumented coefficient-fit dispatch.

numerical_consistency_bound.scope: coefficients/covariance/parameters/lambdas/EDF/objective/likelihood; not the near-zero score whose relative error is uninformative
numerical_consistency_bound.limitation: Conservative condition-aware consistency check, not a universal forward-error proof for complete iterative fits.
